Messages.Author: Daneel
Messages.Body:
I will need an official clarification on these.

1. Can Mata Hari play Clan Loyalty when Anton blocks her?
(I think not: IMHO Clan Loyalty does not have a specific
requirement her special could fulfill.)

2. What if she was performing a recruit War Ghoul action?
(I don't think it matters: the War Ghoul card is the only
card that treats her like a Tzimisce. For all other cards
and effects she is treated a Ravnos.)

--
Bye,

Daneel
